limitations: The legacy generator extends a 200-query base; some added queries and conversational replies reuse indexed captions or text_blob. Query independence is not established.
Task-rule ranks mix video, point-ID and loose temporal criteria. They are not pooled temporal retrieval accuracy or official DRES scores.
The historical runner does not invoke a VLM. The timer excludes real VLM generation, UI interaction and DRES submission.
Per-query ranks, independent labels and effective encoder, checkpoint, index and hardware identities were not preserved in the aggregate.
VQA, safety, hallucination, conversational proxy and composite fields from the original file are intentionally excluded because they do not establish the corresponding end-to-end capabilities.
These archived values do not evaluate the maintained native WeMM pipeline or its corrected VQA replay.
